textos.Dirigido por Charlotte Wells e lançado e: Directed by Charlotte Wells and released in 2022, the drama Aftersun follows eleven-year-old Sophie as she enjoys a vacation with her loving, idealistic father, Calum, at a run-down resort. Twenty years later, the memories of that time take on new contours in the protagonist's mind. These recollections of their last vacation together become a powerful and painful portrait of the relationship between the two.
textos.A narrativa adota uma cadência deliberad: The narrative adopts a deliberately slow, contemplative cadence, building its atmosphere from the reconstruction of memories and everyday moments. The structure rests on silences and subtle observations, recording the intimate time together during the summer holiday. The handling prioritizes the sensitivity of moments over fast-moving dramatic events.
